During their [[Chubbit resistance|resistance]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], a band of [[Chubbit]]s '''ambushed''' an Imperial [[Hovertrain/Legends|hover-train]] passing through the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. However, the Chubbits were outmatched. Fortunately for their side, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], witnessed the ambush as it progressed. Skywalker and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] joined the assault, hurling bags of [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenades]] at the train and destroying it.<ref name="CSW10" />
